essence: Unthought-clear held; self means in self-making.
Five thread cause; gained stage re-becomes.

sections.SUMMARY: Space-time-difference course sunders knowings into varied shine for knower. Both pure-impure wayed by difference; outcast-object purity dives in I-ness. Immersed impurity unresting; infinite between-states graded. Fit knowers share showing; else split knower-known. Thought-free clear creation held Shambhu's; self instrumented in self-making. Doing-knowing-self-knowing-power thread difference-cause; kalā-lore gained re-becomes. Knowledge-means fancied action cut-cut; doing-knowing-striving when.

rasa.dominant: adbhuta of varied shine; adbhuta of diving purity; karuṇa-adbhuta of graded between; vīra of shared-split; śānta of held making; vīra of re-becoming; vīra of cut-open
rasa.sthayibhava: vismaya at sundered-varied; vismaya at outcast-dived; karuṇā-vismaya at unresting grades; utsāha at common-yet-split; śama at unthought-clear; utsāha at threaded-return; utsāha at cut-cut-when
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is wonder: sundered, varied, shone. Shining relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: both wayed, outcast dived. Diving relished. The sthāyibhāva is compassion-wonder: stained sunken, graded between. Grading relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: shared showing, split pair. Dividing relished. The sthāyibhāva is peace: unthought, clear, held. Holding relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: threaded five, gained, re-become. Threading relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: cut twice, left open. Cutting relished.
